title: Playbook
compareOnlyOne: There is only one version so far.
proposedBanner: v{rev} is proposed. It applies from the next run once you make it active.
earlierBanner: v{rev} is an earlier version, not in use. Making it active again applies it from the next run.
leadDecides: A lead makes it active or discards it.
activatedNotice: v{rev} is now the active playbook — the next run uses it.
noteLabel: Version note — what changed and why (optional)

diff.heading: Compare
diff.sameText: The text is the same in both versions.
diff.identical: v{from} and v{to} are the same.

savedBanner: Saved as v{rev}, a proposal based on v{base}. Nothing changes until you make it active.
outdated: Based on an older version: v{base}, while v{active} is active now. Making it active as it is would undo what changed in between; update it onto v{active} to keep both.
outdatedNoBase: Based on an older version: v{base}, which no longer exists. Compare it with v{active} before making it active.
outdatedRoot: Written from scratch while no version was active; v{active} is active now. Compare it with v{active} before making it active.
updatedNotice: v{from} was updated onto v{active} as v{rev}, still a proposal.
updatedConflicts: v{from} was updated onto v{active} as v{rev}. Both changed {what}; v{from}'s version was kept. Compare before making it active.
updatedKept: v{from} is unchanged and still listed.
